subject: Web Development
title: The Framework Churn Problem
description: A quick win: understand The Framework Churn Problem.

hook.text: Every year a new JavaScript framework appears and everyone says it will replace the last one.

buildup.text: Backbone gave way to Angular, then React, then Vue, then Svelte, and on and on.

discovery.text: Developers spend as much time learning new tools as they do building actual products.

twist.text: The constant churn is exhausting, but it also drives genuine innovation at a breakneck pace.

climax.text: JavaScript fatigue is real — but the ecosystem's energy is what keeps the web advancing.

punchline.text: The web's strength is also its exhaustion.
